newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks seen treading in cautious waters.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks seen treading in cautious waters.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was seen treading cautiously on Thursday following a spate of profit-taking overnight, dealers said.
Sentiment was also dampened by recent volatility in regional currencies. Political turmoil in Cambodia is adding to the region's instability, they said.

"I expect the Straits Times Industrials (STI) index to trade around 1,980-2,000 in the coming weeks. I am expecting nothing from Friday's budget and only looking forward to the next set of financial results to see how the market is panning out," said an analyst with a local brokerage.

The STI index fell 24.26 points or 1.21 percent to end at 1,982.97 on Wednesday while Wall Street, in another likely negative for Thursday's Singapore trade, ended down a sharp 119.88 points, or 1.51 percent.
